name: USD Coin
oneLiner: USDC is Circle's centralized dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 and backed by short-term U.S. Treasuries, repos, and cash held in an SEC-regulated reserve fund.
collateral: Cash and cash equivalents held in the Circle Reserve Fund (SEC-registered 2a-7 government money market fund), managed by BlackRock and custodied at BNY Mellon; assets include short-dated U.S. Treasuries, overnight Treasury repos, and cash

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDC is publicly issued as a U.S. dollar payment stablecoin with 1:1 redemption and monthly reserve attestations.

genius.licensingRegulator: OCC (conditional national trust bank charter for First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A.; current issuer licensed as state MTL/NYDFS BitLicense)
genius.notes: Circle received conditional OCC approval on Dec 12 2025 for First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A. — a federal-qualified-nonbank trust charter pathway consistent with the GENIUS Act framework. This is a conditional charter under existing OCC authority, not a PPSI approval; GENIUS Act rulemaking remains in proposed-rules phase with no approvals granted. Pharos found no token-specific public GENIUS PPSI approval as of review.

mintAuthority.summary: USDC is issuer-minted by Circle; Ethereum USDC uses a MasterMinter (MinterAdmin) contract for minter management and an EOA token owner/admin. All addressable controls confirmed at block 25294757.

controls.label: Ethereum USDC MasterMinter (MinterAdmin)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294757, masterMinter() on the USDC token returned 0xE982615d461DD5cD06575BbeA87624fda4e3de17. Blockscout confirms this is a MinterAdmin contract (Circle-specific). getMinterManager() on the MinterAdmin returned 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48 (USDC token), confirming it manages USDC minting. MinterAdmin owner() returned 0xc1d9fe41d19dd52cb3ae5d1d3b0030b5d498c704; eth_getCode confirms that address is an EOA (no bytecode), consistent with Circle enterprise MPC/HSM custody.

controls.label: Ethereum USDC token owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294757, owner() on the USDC token returned 0xFcb19e6a322b27c06842A71e8c725399f049AE3a. eth_getCode returned no bytecode (EOA), consistent with Circle enterprise MPC/HSM custody. Proxy admin (storage slot 1, Centre custom proxy) = 0x4914f61d25e5c567143774b76edbf4d5109a8566; eth_getCode confirms EOA.

controls.label: Ethereum USDC proxy admin

sources.label: FiatTokenProxy admin slot read at block 25591279

controls.evidence: org.zeppelinos.proxy.admin storage slot of the USDC FiatTokenProxy resolves to this admin contract; it can replace the token implementation, including mint logic, with no timelock.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294757: masterMinter() = 0xE982615... (MinterAdmin contract, getMinterManager confirms it manages USDC token); MinterAdmin owner = EOA 0xc1d9fe41...; USDC owner() = EOA 0xFcb19e...; proxy admin slot 1 = EOA 0x4914f61.... All mint-capable addressable controls confirmed as Circle-operated EOAs (enterprise MPC/HSM custody expected). No on-chain multisig; issuer-backend mint model corroborated.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDC's cross-chain route is primarily issuer-native Circle infrastructure, including CCTP burn/mint and Circle Gateway surfaces tracked by L2BEAT Interop. Because the route is issuer-operated and burn/mint based, it is scored as a strong bridge-route profile; the penalty-only Safety Score blend cannot lift USDC's Decentralization score.
